title: OnePass Mobile 365 Days 5G Prepaid SIM 400GB $169 + Free OnePass Membership + 10% TopCashback AU Cashback @ OnePass Mobile
body:
Deal: OnePass Mobile 365 Days 5G Prepaid SIM 400GB $169 + Free OnePass Membership + 10% TopCashback AU Cashback @ OnePass Mobile

[montorola] Optus already has all our details from the last leak, so it'll be prefilled and easier to checkout lol
[cloudie9] Now with iPhone Duo out, does OnePass mobile start supporting eSim?!
[seniordoc] cannot use it as I can only use esim.
which prepaid long expiry can use esim?
[Oz em] Damn, I joined Lyca a few days ago because the one pass plans were all 4g not 5g.
I would have got this if they had it at the time.
[scalebearer] $170 x 0.9 = $153.
$153 / 12 = $12.75 per month.
400GB / 12 = 33GB per month.
Deal should also be amended to indicate it expires on the 10th of November.
[Tanvry] data all at once is better than those monthly plans for those who go on holidays overseas so it's not wasted
[tajid] How long is the delivery normally? Metro nsw
[iamnotintheuk] this has been a great physical sim to use.
The one downside is that I can’t receive text messages while oversea without paying for roaming. Boost has that feature for free.
[ultramic] Kogan has 400gb for $159, esim compatible. Obviously no one pass membership. YMMV.
